description: Structure-equivalenced agmatine pocket across S. pneumoniae 38LX, B. fragilis, C. leptum, V. alginolyticus and VC1624, with each reference residue assigned to the reacting-amine or distal subsite

import requests, numpy as np, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd
b62="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
rows=b62.strip().split('\n'); aas=rows[0].split(); idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(aas)}
SM=np.full((21,21),-4.0)
for r in rows[1:]:
    p=r.split(); i=idx[p[0]]
    for j,v in enumerate(p[1:]): SM[i,j]=float(v)
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,20) for c in s])
NEG=-1e9
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11.0,ge=-1.0):
    a=enc(s1); b=enc(s2); n,m=len(a),len(b)
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    PM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);PX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);PY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0.;X[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n);PX[1:,0]=1;Y[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m);PY[0,1:]=2
    jj=np.arange(m+1); ar=np.arange(m)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        sub=SM[a[i-1]][b]
        pv=np.vstack([M[i-1,:m],X[i-1,:m],Y[i-1,:m]]); k=np.argmax(pv,0); M[i,1:]=pv[k,ar]+sub; PM[i,1:]=k
        pdd=np.vstack([M[i-1,1:]+go,X[i-1,1:]+ge,Y[i-1,1:]+go]); k=np.argmax(pdd,0); X[i,1:]=pdd[k,ar]; PX[i,1:]=k
        base=np.maximum(M[i,:m+1],X[i,:m+1])+go-ge*(jj+1)
        rm=np.maximum.accumulate(base); co=rm[:m]+ge*jj[1:]
        yc=Y[i,0]+ge*jj[1:] if Y[i,0]>NEG/2 else np.full(m,NEG)
        Y[i,1:]=np.maximum(co,yc); PY[i,1:]=np.where(co>=yc,np.where(M[i,:m]>=X[i,:m],0,1),2)
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]])); A1=[];A2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: A1.append('-');A2.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1;continue
        if j==0: A1.append(s1[i-1]);A2.append('-');i-=1;continue
        if st==0: A1.append(s1[i-1]);A2.append(s2[j-1]);st=int(PM[i,j]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: A1.append(s1[i-1]);A2.append('-');st=int(PX[i,j]);i-=1
        else: A1.append('-');A2.append(s2[j-1]);st=int(PY[i,j]);j-=1
    return ''.join(reversed(A1)),''.join(reversed(A2))
def parse_cif_atoms(txt):
    lines=txt.splitlines(); i=0; atoms=[]; cols=[]
    while i<len(lines):
        if lines[i].strip()=='loop_' and i+1<len(lines) and lines[i+1].strip().startswith('_atom_site.'):
            cols=[];j=i+1
            while lines[j].strip().startswith('_atom_site.'): cols.append(lines[j].strip().split('.')[1]); j+=1
            while j<len(lines) and not lines[j].startswith('#'):
                p=lines[j].split()
                if len(p)==len(cols): atoms.append(dict(zip(cols,p)))
                j+=1
            break
        i+=1
    return atoms
def parse_pdb(txt):
    out=[]
    for l in txt.split('\n'):
        if l.startswith('ATOM'):
            out.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),res=l[17:20].strip(),seq=int(l[22:26]),
                            x=float(l[30:38]),y=float(l[38:46]),z=float(l[46:54]),b=float(l[60:66])))
    return out
def kabsch_fit(Q,P):
    qc=Q.mean(0); pc=P.mean(0)
    U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd((Q-qc).T@(P-pc)); d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))
    return Vt.T@np.diag([1.,1.,d])@U.T, qc, pc
THREE={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
       'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}

cif=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/38LX.cif",timeout=120).text
at=parse_cif_atoms(cif)
prot=[a for a in at if a['group_PDB']=='ATOM' and a['label_asym_id']==[x['label_asym_id'] for x in at if x['label_comp_id']=='AG2'][0][:1] or False]
ref_atoms=[a for a in at if a['group_PDB']=='ATOM']
spn_ca={int(a['auth_seq_id']):np.array([float(a['Cartn_x']),float(a['Cartn_y']),float(a['Cartn_z'])]) for a in ref_atoms if a['label_atom_id']=='CA'}
spn_res={int(a['auth_seq_id']):THREE.get(a['label_comp_id'],'X') for a in ref_atoms if a['label_atom_id']=='CA'}
AGat=[a for a in at if a['label_comp_id']=='AG2']
AG=np.array([[float(a['Cartn_x']),float(a['Cartn_y']),float(a['Cartn_z'])] for a in AGat])
AGn=[a['label_atom_id'] for a in AGat]
iN=AGn.index('N'); gidx=[AGn.index(x) for x in ('NE','CZ','NH1','NH2')]
cen=AG.mean(0); local_ref={r for r,c in spn_ca.items() if np.linalg.norm(c-cen)<20.0}
# reference's own pocket residues (all atoms)
RX=np.array([[float(a['Cartn_x']),float(a['Cartn_y']),float(a['Cartn_z'])] for a in ref_atoms])
RS=[int(a['auth_seq_id']) for a in ref_atoms]
DR=np.linalg.norm(RX[:,None,:]-AG[None,:,:],axis=2)
refpock={}
for i,s in enumerate(RS):
    mm=float(DR[i].min())
    if mm<=5.0:
        e=refpock.get(s,(99,99,99))
        refpock[s]=(min(e[0],mm),min(e[1],float(DR[i,iN])),min(e[2],float(DR[i,gidx].min())))
refpos=sorted(refpock)
print("38LX (S. pneumoniae CAPADH, agmatine + NADPH) own pocket residues within 5.0 A of agmatine:")
for s in refpos:
    v=refpock[s]; print(f"  {spn_res[s]}{s:<5} dmin={v[0]:.2f}  d(reacting N)={v[1]:.2f}  d(guanidinium)={v[2]:.2f}")

SPN=''.join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/A0A0H2ZP94.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:]).strip()
TARGETS=[('S. pneumoniae 38LX (ref)',None),('B. fragilis (I9VY56)','I9VY56'),('C. leptum (A7VSG1)','A7VSG1'),
         ('V. alginolyticus (P0DPE4)','P0DPE4'),('VC1624 (Q9KRL3)','Q9KRL3')]
grid={}; meta={}
grid['S. pneumoniae 38LX (ref)']={s:f"{spn_res[s]}{s}" for s in refpos}
meta['S. pneumoniae 38LX (ref)']=dict(rmsd=0.0,n=len(spn_ca))
for label,acc in TARGETS[1:]:
    pa=parse_pdb(requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{acc}-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120).text)
    tca={a['seq']:np.array([a['x'],a['y'],a['z']]) for a in pa if a['name']=='CA'}
    tres={a['seq']:THREE.get(a['res'],'X') for a in pa if a['name']=='CA'}
    tseq=''.join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:]).strip()
    a1,a2=nw(SPN,tseq); ri=qi=0; pairs=[]
    for c1,c2 in zip(a1,a2):
        if c1!='-': ri+=1
        if c2!='-': qi+=1
        if c1!='-' and c2!='-' and ri in spn_ca and qi in tca: pairs.append((ri,qi))
    eq={r:q for r,q in pairs}
    P=np.array([spn_ca[r] for r,q in pairs if r in local_ref]); Q=np.array([tca[q] for r,q in pairs if r in local_ref])
    keep=np.ones(len(P),bool)
    for _ in range(10):
        R,qc,pc=kabsch_fit(Q[keep],P[keep]); d=np.linalg.norm((Q-qc)@R.T+pc-P,axis=1); new=d<2.0
        if new.sum()<40: new=d<np.percentile(d,80)
        if (new==keep).all(): break
        keep=new
    R,qc,pc=kabsch_fit(Q[keep],P[keep]); lr=np.sqrt((((Q[keep]-qc)@R.T+pc-P[keep])**2).sum(1).mean())
    grid[label]={s:(f"{tres[eq[s]]}{eq[s]}" if s in eq else "gap") for s in refpos}
    meta[label]=dict(rmsd=round(float(lr),2),n=int(keep.sum()))
    print(f"\n{label}: local pocket superposition {keep.sum()} CA, RMSD {lr:.2f} A")

df=pd.DataFrame(grid).T[refpos]
df.to_csv('pocket_equivalence_structural.csv')
print("\nStructure-equivalenced pocket table (columns = 38LX pocket positions):")
print(df.to_string())

# ---- figure ----
labels=list(grid); ncol=len(refpos)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(1.05*ncol+3.5,6.4),gridspec_kw=dict(height_ratios=[2.5,1.15]))
ax=axes[0]
refaa=[spn_res[s] for s in refpos]
for i,lab in enumerate(labels):
    for j,s in enumerate(refpos):
        txt=grid[lab][s]; aa=txt[0] if txt!="gap" else "-"
        col='#d9f0d3' if aa==refaa[j] else ('#fddbc7' if txt!="gap" else '#cccccc')
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((j,-i),1,1,facecolor=col,edgecolor='white',lw=1.5))
        ax.text(j+0.5,-i+0.5,txt,ha='center',va='center',fontsize=7.6,
                fontweight='bold' if aa!=refaa[j] else 'normal')
ax.set_xlim(0,ncol); ax.set_ylim(-len(labels)+1,1)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(ncol)+0.5)
ax.set_xticklabels([f"{spn_res[s]}{s}" for s in refpos],rotation=90,fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(-np.arange(len(labels))+0.5)
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{l}  (fit RMSD {meta[l]['rmsd']} A)" for l in labels],fontsize=8.5)
ax.tick_params(length=0); [sp.set_visible(False) for sp in ax.spines.values()]
# mark the NEFE motif columns
nefe=[j for j,s in enumerate(refpos) if spn_res[s] in 'NEF' and refpock[s][2]<refpock[s][1]]
for j in nefe: ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((j,-len(labels)+1),1,len(labels),fill=False,edgecolor='#2166ac',lw=2.0))
ax.set_title("Agmatine pocket of 38LX mapped onto four homologs by local structural superposition\n"
             "green = same as S. pneumoniae reference, orange = substituted; blue boxes = distal (guanidinium-facing) positions",
             fontsize=9.5)
ax2=axes[1]
w=0.4; xs=np.arange(ncol)
ax2.bar(xs-w/2,[refpock[s][1] for s in refpos],w,label='distance to reacting primary amine (N)',color='#4393c3')
ax2.bar(xs+w/2,[refpock[s][2] for s in refpos],w,label='distance to distal guanidinium',color='#d6604d')
ax2.set_xticks(xs); ax2.set_xticklabels([f"{spn_res[s]}{s}" for s in refpos],rotation=90,fontsize=8)
ax2.set_ylabel('distance in 38LX (A)',fontsize=8.5); ax2.legend(fontsize=7.5,frameon=False)
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False); ax2.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax2.set_title("Which end of the bound amine each pocket residue contacts",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
